lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.en: Can you make the tea, Sam?

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.en: Yes, of course I can, Penny.

lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.en: Is there any water in this kettle?

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.en: It's over there, behind the teapot. Can you see it?

lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.en: I can see the teapot, but I can't see the tea.

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.en: There it is! It's in front of you.

lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.en: Ah yes, I can see it now.

lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.en: There are some in the cupboard.

lines.speaker: PENNY
lines.en: Hurry up, Sam. The kettle's boiling.

43: 萨姆：会的，我当然会，彭妮。
彭妮：就在那儿，茶壶后面。
萨姆：茶壶我看见了，但茶叶没看到。
彭妮：那不是么！ 就在你眼前。
萨姆：噢，是啊，我现在看到了。
萨姆：找得到。就在这儿呢。
